components.name: Button
components.summary: Triggers an action; black by default, red for the one action that matters most on a view.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Square, icon-only Button — ghost by default — for toolbars, table rows and headers.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Line icon from the built-in Lucide set (ISC licence, icons-LICENSE.txt), drawn on a 24px grid with a 2px stroke in currentColor.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Single-line text field, optionally wrapped with label, helper and error text.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Wraps any control with label, required mark, helper text and error text — the one way to label form controls.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line input with the same variants, borders and focus ring as Input.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Native styled exactly like Input (same heights, borders, focus ring) with a chevron.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Searchable select for long lists — images, profiles, projects, networks, cluster members.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: Adds an icon, button or text addon to an Input: search icon, copy button, unit (GiB), prefix (https://).

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Square checkbox (native input) with label and optional description; supports indeterminate.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Group of radio buttons in a fieldset with legend, vertical or horizontal.

components.name: SegmentGroup
components.summary: Segmented control for switching a filter or view: items on a recessed bg-muted track, the selected one raised.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: On/off toggle that takes effect immediately (settings), not a form choice to submit later.

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: Drop zone with click-to-pick; lists chosen files with their size.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small non-interactive status label for counts, states and categories.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Compact label for things attached to an object: profiles, images, projects, networks, architecture — optionally with icon and remove button.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Container that groups one subject: header (title, description), body and an actions footer.

components.name: DataList
components.summary: Key–value pairs for detail panels: labels in fg-muted, values in fg, optional mono and copy button per value.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Collapsible sections on native : open/close works without JS, one-at-a-time via the name attribute unless multiple.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline message that tells the user about a state: info, success, warning, error or neutral.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate loading indicator in currentColor.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder block while data loads, pulsing on bg-emphasized.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Centered message when a list has nothing to show: icon, title, description, actions.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Short-lived notification, bottom right.

components.name: Status
components.summary: Coloured dot plus label for the state of a service, host, container or job.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Usage meter for CPU, RAM, disk, quota or a running job.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: One metric on a dashboard: muted label, large tabular value, small unit, optional trend and help text.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Dense data table for hosts, containers, ports, logs: tabular numbers, optional monospace columns, horizontal scroll on small screens.

components.name: ActionBar
components.summary: Floating toolbar at the bottom centre for bulk actions on selected rows ("3 selected · Start · Stop · Delete").

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Time series — CPU, RAM, network, disk I/O over time.

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Compare one value across categories — RAM per instance, disk per pool, backups per day.

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: Tiny trend line without axes for table cells, Stat tiles and lists: 1.5px ink line, 10 % fill, a dot on the last value; hover shows the value.

components.name: Container
components.summary: Centred page width for websites: sm 40rem · md 48rem · lg 64rem (default) · xl 80rem · full.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: Flex stack with a spacing-token gap. direction="row" wraps by default, so toolbars (filter, search, buttons) flow onto the next line on phones instead of overf…

components.name: Grid
components.summary: Responsive grid without media queries: as many columns as fit, each at least minChildWidth wide (default 16rem) — four stat cards on desktop, two on a tablet,…

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: Page title with description and actions.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switch between views of one object (Overview, Configuration, Snapshots, Console, Logs).

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Path to the current page (project › section › object) in the header.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page switcher with range text ("61–80 von 243"), prev/next and numbered pages with ellipses.

components.name: Steps
components.summary: Progress through a multi-step flow (create instance: Image → Resources → Network → Review).

components.name: Nav
components.summary: Sidebar navigation: sections with optional titles, items with icon, label and a count badge; the active item on bg-emphasized.

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: Page layout for apps: fixed sidebar (brand, Nav, footer), 56px header, scrolling main area.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal for decisions and short forms, on the native element: the browser handles focus trap, Esc and stacking.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side panel on native for details and edit forms without leaving the list.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Dropdown of actions for an object (row actions, user menu).

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Short hint on hover (after 300 ms) and on keyboard focus, on bg-inverted.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: User or object picture with initials fallback and optional status dot.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Small floating panel anchored to a button — filters, quick settings, info — in the top layer (never clipped).

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: Ctrl/⌘+K search over pages and actions: grouped, fuzzy-ish filtering (accents ignored, prefix first), ↑↓ Enter, shortcut hints.

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Numeric field with steppers: ↑↓ keys (Shift = ×10), min/max/step clamped on blur, decimal comma accepted, optional unit suffix (GiB, %), numeric keyboard on ph…

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Native range input styled with the palette: label, live value (unit, formatValue), optional marks.

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.summary: Circular usage gauge for compact dashboards; like Progress it colours itself by thresholds (black < 75 % ≤ orange < 90 % ≤ red).

components.name: RelativeTime
components.summary: “5 minutes ago” / “in 3 hours” via Intl in the current locale, updating itself; hover shows the exact date.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Activity feed / event log: dots (status colours) or icons, title, relative time, description and optional content.

components.name: UptimeBar
components.summary: Status-page style bars — one per day or check — green up, orange degraded, red down, grey no data; hover/focus shows the day, the header the uptime %.

components.name: KeyValueEditor
components.summary: Edit key–value lists: env variables, config keys, labels.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: Hierarchy on native : storage pools → volumes, projects → instances, folders → files.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: Light/dark switch that remembers the choice (localStorage kui-theme) and follows the OS when set to System.

components.name: Navbar
components.summary: Website header: brand, links, actions (ThemeToggle, CTA).

components.name: Hero
components.summary: Opening section of a landing page: optional eyebrow (accent red text or a Status), fluid title (36–72px, balanced lines), description, actions. align="center"…

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.summary: Grid of features with icon tile, title and text; responsive via Grid (minChildWidth 15rem).

components.name: Footer
components.summary: Website footer: brand, link columns (auto-fit), bottom line with copyright.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: Full-width announcement bar above the navigation: inverted (default), accent (one urgent message), subtle.

components.name: SkipLink
components.summary: “Skip to content” — hidden until focused with Tab, jumps to #main.

components.name: Heading
components.summary: Section and page titles in Inter 600, sizes from the type scale.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Inline text link: fg text with a thin accent-border underline that turns accent-fg and thicker on hover — the red, on purpose.

components.name: Code
components.summary: Inline code in the mono stack on bg-muted with a border-muted hairline, radius-l2.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: Keyboard key: mono, bg-panel, border-emphasized with a 2px bottom edge.

components.name: Blockquote
components.summary: Quoted text with a 2px border-emphasized rule, text in fg-muted.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: 1px border hairline, horizontal (an ) or vertical (between inline items in a toolbar), optionally dashed.

components.name: List
components.summary: Bulleted or numbered list with fg-muted markers and 0.25em between items.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Multi-line code in a framed block: header with title and/or language, copy button, mono 13/20 text on bg-subtle.

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: Always-dark console frame with a header (title, status, actions) and a black mono body — the place to mount xterm.js for incus exec/console sessions.

components.name: Prose
components.summary: Layout wrapper for rendered Markdown.

components.name: Confirm
components.summary: Promise-based confirmation: if (await KenosUI.confirm({ title, description, danger: true, confirmText: 'web01' })) ….
